title: Damage model

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

entity.description: What the rule belongs to: the damageable entity the game's table row names, such as `Infantry`, `Armor`, `Helmet`, `Armor.Ghillie`, `Vehicle` or one vehicle (`Vehicle.Air.Rotary.Havoc`). The `Meta.Damage.` prefix is dropped.

source.description: Tags the incoming damage must carry for the rule to apply, such as `Bullet`, `Bullet.556mm`, `Bullet.AmmoModifier.HollowPoint` or `Explosive.Rocket.84mm`. All of them must match. Empty means any damage.

target.description: Tags the target must carry, such as `Armor`, `Helmet.SuperHeavy`. Empty means any target.

instigator.description: Tags the attacker must carry. Empty means any attacker.

hitLocations.description: Hit locations the rule is limited to (`Vehicle.MainRotor`, `Infantry.Head`), or attribute tags for vehicle parts. Empty means anywhere.

alignment.description: `Friendly` for rules that only apply to damage between teammates. Absent otherwise.

category.description: The group the game applies the rule in, such as `Weapon`, `Calibre`, `AmmoModifier`, `Armor`, `Bone`, `Penetration`. Rules of one category do not stack the way different categories do.

operation.description: How the amount changes the damage. `Percentage_Ongoing` reads as a percentage change to the running damage: -20 is 20% less and 100 doubles it. `Add` adds a flat amount of damage (tracked vehicles crushing buildables). The game's own code decides the exact order rules apply in.

amount.description: The amount: a percentage for `Percentage_Ongoing`, damage points for `Add`.

custom.description: Name of the game's own code that computes the real effect when the rule is not a plain percentage (for example `B_BoneDamageModifiers_C`, which applies the hit-location multipliers). Absent for plain rules.

items.description: One rule in the game's damage model. Rules that do nothing are left out.

rules.description: The damage rules, grouped by entity in the game's order. Order inside an entity matters to the game.

weaponClass.description: `Universal`, or the weapon class the multipliers are for, such as `Weapon.AR`, `Weapon.Sniper`. The `Meta.Damage.` prefix is dropped.

multipliers.description: Damage multiplier per hit location, keyed by location (`Head`, `Neck`, `Torso.Upper`, ...).

items.description: Damage multiplier by body part for one weapon class.

modifier.description: Penetration effectiveness multiplier of the ammo type.

byArmsClass.description: Multiplier by weapon arms class (`Small`, `Medium`, `High`, `Special`) that replaces `modifier` for that class. Empty when the game gives none.

items.description: How well an ammo type penetrates armor.

damageSources.description: Arms classes the reduction applies to (`Small`, `Medium`, `High`, `Special`).

reduction.description: Percent change to damage the occupant takes; -90 is 90% less.

rules.description: Damage reduction for a person sitting in the vehicle, by arms class.

items.description: How much a vehicle protects its occupants.

description: The game's damage model: percentage rules by source, target and hit location (ammo types, calibers, armor, vehicles), body-part multipliers by weapon class, ammo-type penetration, and occupant protection in vehicles. Base damage per hit is in ammo.json; this file says what happens to it.
